name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.easily.SpeechVoiceEasilyQuitDialogActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user tries to exit an easy ad-reward task. It shows the task's quit prompt and the reward that may be lost.
disableEffect: The task-exit warning will not appear, and users cannot continue the task through this dialog.
